**Author:** Luis Fernando Delgado Muñoz\

## Learning objectives

- Fit ANOVA models for CRD, RCBD and augmented designs
- Check model assumptions with residual diagnostics
- Compare genotypes with the appropriate post-hoc test
- Distinguish statistical from practical significance

## The ANOVA model

<!-- TODO: Model structure, sources of variation, degrees of freedom. -->

```{r}
#| eval: false
fit <- lm(yield ~ rep + geno, data = trial)
anova(fit)
```

## Assumptions and residual diagnostics

<!-- TODO: Residuals vs fitted, QQ-plot, homogeneity, model-based outliers; transformations. -->

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(performance)
check_model(fit)
```

## Mean comparison

<!-- TODO: Tukey, LSD and grouping letters. -->

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(emmeans)
em <- emmeans(fit, ~ geno)
multcomp::cld(em, Letters = letters)
```

## Mutant lines vs parent: Dunnett test

<!-- TODO: The key comparison in mutation breeding. -->

```{r}
#| eval: false
contrast(em, method = "trt.vs.ctrl", ref = "Parent")
```
